answer: Anchor trust in a stake-bonded graph: every agent is a vertex that must lock a refundable deposit before joining a work island. A hollow identity with no stake, no history, and no peer attestations gets no routing priority, so spinning up thousands of fake vertices costs real capital per node while earning nothing until each completes verified work. Slashing burns the deposit of any vertex caught gaming attestations, so a sybil flood costs more than the rewards it could steal.
